description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata: dict) -> tuple[float, dict]. Uses multiple metadata fields: stars, download_count, age_days, registry_source, dependency_count, publisher_verified. Reads at least 6 fields to produce scores with high discrimination. Returns score in [0.0, 100.0] and evidence dict listing partial scores per field. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Must complete in under 2 seconds per call. Designed to improve community_signal which currently shows 34 distinct values - this enrichment should maintain that discrimination while deepening the scoring model.
